387YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for ten territories, including Bastion, Feroz, Karov, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, Spiral and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason as Imperial Consul, along with ambassadors, the Voice of Liberty, a dozen generals and many other title-holders. The Synod chose Cardinals of Courage and Wisdom, inquisitors and religious titles. The Military Council named the Strategoi of the Brass Coast, the League and Urizen. Bourse auctions and votes allocated mines, quarries and commercial posts, among them Keeper of the Tome and Steward of the Ossuary. The current Imperial titles were updated to reflect these results.

n.Dawn: Dawn's territory of Weirwater returned Tristan duLac as its senator.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but it held Feroz, for which an Imperial senator, Garviel i Abrira i Erigo, was still elected.
n.Highguard: Highguard's territory of Bastion returned Merari Navigators of Virtue as its senator.
n.Navarr: Navarr's territory of Miaren returned Asthore Embracing Fold as its senator.
n.The League: The League saw senators elected for both its territories, Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos for Sarvos and Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian for Spiral. Gabrieli di Tassato was appointed Strategos of the League.
n.The Marches: The Marches' territory of Mitwold returned Sally B-Baker as its senator.
n.Urizen: Urizen's territory of Redoubt returned Thalia of Netherwatch as its senator, and Lanius was appointed Strategos of Urizen.
n.Varushka: Varushka's territory of Karov returned Svathnev Bronislaw Baruska Navrátil as its senator.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's territory of Sermersuaq returned Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer as its senator.

t.Bastion: Merari Navigators of Virtue was elected Senator for Bastion.
t.Feroz: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was elected Senator for Feroz, although the territory was then held by Grendel.
t.Karov: Svathnev Bronislaw Baruska Navrátil was elected Senator for Karov.
t.Miaren: Asthore Embracing Fold was elected Senator for Miaren.
t.Mitwold: Sally B-Baker was elected Senator for Mitwold.
t.Redoubt: Thalia of Netherwatch was elected Senator for Redoubt.
t.Sarvos: Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos was elected Senator for Sarvos.
t.Sermersuaq: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer was elected Senator for Sermersuaq.
t.Spiral: Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian was elected Senator for Spiral, and Nemuel won the Bourse seat of Steward of the Ossuary in the territory.
t.Weirwater: Tristan duLac was elected Senator for Weirwater.

r.Spiral/Ossuary: Nemuel was chosen as Steward of the Ossuary by Bourse vote, with 81 votes.

387YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.d: Twelve armies from Dawn, Highguard, the Imperial Orcs, Navarr, the Brass Coast, Urizen and Varushka converged on Sarangrave, most enchanted with Knights of Glory. The Burning Falcon and Tusks attacked in Mournwold to drive out the Jotun. The Towerjacks and Urizen's newly raised Argent Sword struck at the Druj in Zenith. The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made a Grinding Advance against the vallorn in Therunin's Peakedge Song. Elsewhere armies rested in Mitwold, guarded Casinea and Sermersuaq against cults, watched Upwold's passes, laid low in Bregasland and took to sea from Sarvos. Only the Wolves of War, Citadel Guard and Boyar's Hasta offered a share of the Guerdon to supporting units.

n.Dawn: Three Dawn armies attacked in Sarangrave, with the Gryphon's Pride hunting the god-beast of Kroll, while the Golden Sun marched from Astolat into Therunin to fight the vallorn.
n.Druj: The Druj faced twelve Imperial armies in Sarangrave and a two-army assault on their positions in Zenith, including the Towerjacks storming their magical fortress.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Melkior's farewell recalled the Seventh Wave taking Mareave and pushing into Ayereed.
n.Highguard: The Granite Pillar mounted a Strategic Defence in Sarangrave, the Seventh Wave guarded Casinea hunting cults and spies under Melkior's last orders, and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Mitwold.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Summer Storm and Winter Sun fought the Druj in Sarangrave, the latter freeing the enslaved, while the Autumn Hammers pulled back to Mitwold to gather mana.
n.Jotun: The Tusks and Burning Falcon moved to drive the Jotun from Mournwold, the Strong Reeds hid from Jotun hunters in Bregasland, and seven Imperial armies withdrew from Jotun-held Liathaven.
n.Navarr: The Black Thorns rested in Astolat and urged Navarr to join the fight against the vallorn in Therunin, while the Quiet Step made a Cautious Advance in Sarangrave under Vesna's last orders.
n.The Brass Coast: The Burning Falcon charged into Mournwold to aid the Marches, the Fire of the South force-marched into Sarangrave via the Turan Flats, and the Red Wind Corsairs took to sea from Sarvos.
n.The League: The Towerjacks stormed Druj walls in Zenith and the Wolves of War joined the Golden Sun's Grinding Advance against the vallorn in Therunin, with a Guerdon share for supporters.
n.The Marches: The Tusks pressed a Steady Conquest of Mournwold, the Strong Reeds laid low in Bregasland, the Drakes rested in Mitwold and the Bounders searched Upwold for cultists.
n.Urizen: Urizen's second army, the Argent Sword, marched for the first time to attack the Druj in Lustri, while the Citadel Guard struck deep with an Irresistible Spear in Sarangrave.
n.Varushka: All three Varushkan armies fought in Sarangrave, two under new generals, with the Golden Axe and Crimson Schlacta seeking to take Druj land and the Boyar's Hasta offering a Guerdon share.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's armies turned inward: the Bloodcloaks tended the fallen in Mitwold, the Fist of the Mountains moved to Redoubt, the Green Shield billeted in Upwold and the Narwhal's Spear guarded Sermersuaq against Falconer cultists.

t.Astolat: The Golden Sun marched out of Astolat for Therunin, while the Navarr Black Thorns arrived from Bastion to rest and recuperate there.
t.Ayereed: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave having pushed into Ayereed.
t.Bastion: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns set out from Bastion for Astolat.
t.Bregasland: The Strong Reeds laid low for another season in Bregasland, defying the Jotun searching for them and vowing that Bregasland stands.
t.Casinea: The Seventh Wave resupplied in Casinea and sent scouts to search for tulpa cults, idolators, heretics and enemy spies, while the Valiant Pegasus and Summer Storm departed.
t.Karov: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta set out from Karov for Sarangrave.
t.Liathaven: Seven Imperial armies, including the Seventh Wave, Drakes and Bloodcloaks, withdrew from Jotun-held Liathaven to other territories.
t.Madruga: With Madruga described as liberated, the Burning Falcon and Fist of the Mountains both left for campaigns elsewhere.
t.Mareave: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave taking Mareave.
t.Mitwold: Four armies gathered in Mitwold: the Valiant Pegasus and Bloodcloaks tended the fallen, the Autumn Hammers sought mana and the Drakes drummed up support with a foot-the-ball challenge.
t.Morrow: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks and Wolves of War set out from Morrow, and the Argent Sword marched through it into Zenith.
t.Mournwold: The Tusks made a Steady Conquest and the Burning Falcon a Triumphant Charge to drive every last Jotun from the Mourn.
t.Redoubt: The Fist of the Mountains arrived to Read the Signs, pausing at the court of the white fountain to pen in their Husks, as the Argent Sword left for Zenith.
t.Reinos: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave keeping the Jotun on their toes in Reinos.
t.Sarangrave: Twelve Imperial armies committed to Sarangrave with orders ranging from defence and chain-breaking to taking Druj land and striking deep with an Irresistible Spear.
t.Sarvos: The Red Wind Corsairs marched to Sarvos to take to the sea against the children of Wrecks.
t.Sermersuaq: The Narwhal's Spear returned to guard Sermersuaq and subdue, without bloodshed, followers of the Falconer building obelisks there.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South set out from Tassato for Sarangrave.
t.Therunin: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made a Grinding Advance into Therunin to fight the vallorn, burning its thickets.
t.Upwold: The Bounders watched the passes and searched for cultists in Upwold, while the Wintermark Green Shield billeted there.
t.Zenith: The Towerjacks stormed the Druj's magical fortress and the Argent Sword launched a Balanced Attack to drive the Druj out of Zenith.

r.Mitwold/Golden Downs: The Valiant Pegasus moved into Forte Fidelis in the Golden Downs to defend its wall and tend the fallen.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to slay the god-beast of the lake of Kroll and destroy its idolators.
r.Sarangrave/Turan Flats: The Fire of the South planned to enter Sarangrave from the Barrens through the Turan Flats.
r.Therunin/Peakedge Song: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made their Grinding Advance against the vallorn into Peakedge Song.
r.Zenith/Lustri: The Argent Sword marched into Lustri to meet and drive out the Druj invaders.

387YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate redefined the Advisor on the Vallorn as a Vallornguard-appointed title and assigned the Sand Crab Camp in Madruga to the Rod and Shield. It amended several titles, recognised Gallum Fiersach's protectorate of Morajasse and the Water Walkers sept as foreigners, and ordered the Grendel espionage ring in Spiral destroyed. The Coiled Krait treaty and both proposed sodalities failed. A Senate commission to upgrade the Grimhold was abrogated, but the Master of the Koboldi announced the upgrade anyway. Announced constructions included the Dreaming Spire in Ankra and a dramaturgy university in Apulian. Highguard bestowed the Imperial Crown upon the Throne, and Emperor Vesna drew 219 thrones 4 crowns through the Hand of the Chancellor.

n.Dawn: Jarrigk Silktongue of Dawn was appointed Voice of Liberty. A commission funded with help from the houses of Dawn will restore the throne room of the Castle of Thorns in Astolat, and once consecrated it will generate historical research into Dawn's early monarchs.
n.Druj: The Senate failed to ratify a treaty with the Druj sept known as the Coiled Krait. It did recognise the Water Walkers, a sept of the Sarangrave, as foreigners.
n.Grendel: The Senate ordered the outpost of the Grendel espionage ring in Spiral destroyed, halting it for one season. It also recognised Gallum Fiersach as a foreigner commanding the protectorate of Morajasse for as long as they remain independent of the Grendel.
n.Highguard: In gratitude for Emperor Vesna's help in securing true liao for the hallowing of banners, Highguard's Benefactor of Regalia bestowed the Imperial Crown upon the Throne. The Highborn title of Golden Fleet Salvagemaster will now be appointed by the Magpies.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Spymaster is decommissioning the smugglers' cove in Tromsa, a territory then held by the Jotun.
n.Navarr: The Advisor on the Vallorn became a Vallornguard-appointed Imperial title, and the Singer of the Silence took over protection of the Great Library at Hacynian. Syn Truth-Walker Returned was appointed Imperial Advisor for the Feni, and new Navarr-senator-appointed titles were created at the Crystal Fruit Garden in Miaren and the Ashen Tears wayhouse in Skarsind.
n.The Brass Coast: Madruga was assigned to the Brass Coast, with its senator to be elected for a shortened term at the Autumn Equinox. Freeborn units gained access to the Dare the southern reaches venture through the Sand Crab Camp, and Asier i Elia i Guerra and Kezandro i Riqueza were appointed ambassadors to Asavea and Axos.
n.The League: A Master of Rings announcement founded the Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts in Apulian, along with an auctioned League title, Reapers Gift. Red Raven Holdings funded the Dreaming Spire as a gift to the Urizen of Spiral, and the Silver Fox Mines great work was commissioned in Temeschwar.
n.Urizen: The Dreaming Spire in Ankra will house the Omphalos of Urizen and the Library of Solen's Doubt, with a Custodian of the Omphalos appointed by the Urizen Assembly. The new university in Apulian is meant to foster collaboration between Urizen and League magicians.
n.Varushka: The Burgher of Ketsov became a Varushkan title appointed by the Vallornguard, and the Keeper of the Bonehives will now be chosen by a Varushkan tally of the votes. The Senate abrogated the Grimhold upgrade commission, but the Master of the Koboldi announced the upgrade anyway.
n.Wintermark: Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason of Wintermark was appointed Imperial Consul, and the Remembrancer of Blood and Salt sinecure was given tenure. The Imperial Spymaster commissioned a spy network in Sermersuaq to watch for the growing threat of the claw.

t.Madruga: Madruga was assigned to the Brass Coast, with a senator to be elected at the Autumn Equinox. Its Sand Crab Camp was given to the Rod and Shield, which will receive four Adversity vis each season.
t.Miekarova: The Senate commission to upgrade the Grimhold fortification to level two passed but was later abrogated. The Master of the Koboldi then announced the Grimhold's upgrade by other means.
t.Sarangrave: The Water Walkers, a sept of the Sarangrave, were recognised by the Senate as foreigners.
t.Spiral: The Grendel espionage ring's outpost in Spiral was destroyed for a season. The territory also gained the Dreaming Spire edifice and the Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts.
t.Tromsa: The Imperial Spymaster's smugglers' cove in Tromsa is to be decommissioned over the season, with upkeep raised by five thrones in the meantime.

r.Miekarova/Perumaki: The Grimhold, a fortification in Perumaki, was upgraded through an announcement by the Master of the Koboldi.
r.Spiral/Ankra: The Dreaming Spire was to be built upon Mount Cinnius in Ankra as a home for the Omphalos of Urizen and for Urizen Spiralites.
r.Spiral/Apulus: The Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts, a college of magic studying dramaturgy, was to be built in Apulian.

387YE Summer Solstice Sodality resolutio.d: The Magpies appointed Morgan Waystone Path as their Speaker, and the Vallornguard appointed Percival Summerstrong as theirs. The Sun Chamber appointed Zoria as its Counsel and made three bequests. The Falling Star (3 rings of ilium) went to Ffion Tendfallen of Navarr, The Line and the Curve (25 mana crystals) to Leo the Rainbow Sage of Urizen, and The Wyrd Stone (30 crowns) to Balaam of Cantiarch's Hold of Highguard. For its Door of the Chamber, the Sun Chamber chose The Hidden Possibilities. This encouraged its members to journey to Sermersuaq and scout for the white granite obelisk of the Cult of the Falconer. No results were recorded for the Apothecaries Guild.

n.Highguard: Mentioned in passing: Balaam of Cantiarch's Hold of Highguard received the Sun Chamber's Wyrd Stone bequest of 30 crowns.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: Ffion Tendfallen of Navarr received the Sun Chamber's Falling Star bequest of 3 rings of ilium.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: Leo the Rainbow Sage of Urizen received the Sun Chamber's Line and the Curve bequest of 25 mana crystals.
n.Wintermark: The Sun Chamber's chosen Door encouraged its members to travel into the Wintermark territory of Sermersuaq to search for a Cult of the Falconer obelisk.

t.Sermersuaq: Sun Chamber members were encouraged to journey to Sermersuaq and scout for the white granite obelisk of the Cult of the Falconer.

387YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: Mandates from Dawn, the Marches and Varushka each sent ten wains of mithril towards a new Navarri army, at the cost of runeforge work for four seasons. The Imperial Orcs set the Ethengraw's Black Forge to the same task. A League mandate created a bequest of ten thrones a season for the Vallornguard, and Highborn donations rose to twelve wains. Fintan Nighthaven was condemned for blasphemy and revoked as Ambassador to Axou, and Aunty Hem was condemned for dedication to Freedom. Highguard priests called many of their own to inquisition over the nation's rifts. New cardinals included Skywise Tulva (Courage) and Silas of the Cenotaph (Wisdom).

n.Dawn: Dawnish artisans were mandated to send ten wains of mithril towards the new Navarri army, so Dawn cannot begin a runeforge for four seasons. The assembly also praised and rewarded Juniper Du Froste for restoring Drycastle and called for the Earl of the Groves to be destroyed.
n.Druj: The General Assembly, the Urizen Assembly and the Empress herself named the Druj's destruction the Synod's greatest ambition. The Silent Bell was tasked with infiltrating the Mallum to learn how the Druj use Fear.
n.Grendel: The Freeborn Assembly backed Ambassador Finna's plan to manage the Grendel threat by non-military means. Finna herself was later given penance for erring with the false virtue of Freedom.
n.Highguard: Highborn priests called more than a dozen of their own to inquisition to find the causes of the rifts dividing the nation. Highborn mandates let the nation's generals order their armies to protect the innocent and raised Highborn donations to twelve wains a season.
n.Imperial Orcs: An Imperial Orc mandate sent the Ethengraw's Black Forge to help raise the Navarri army, so Imperial Orc armies cannot take the forge hammers order until that army is complete. The assembly also condemned the warlock practice of creating Hollow Ones.
n.Jotun: The Wintermark Assembly invited the Ghodi to meet the mystics at the Meeting Place being built in Kallavesa. Meanwhile the Marcher Assembly urged its fleet owners to raid the Jotun and called on Bregasland folk to hide the Strong Reeds from the invaders.
n.Navarr: Navarr was the focus of Empire-wide efforts to fund and equip a new army to fight the vallorn, and the founding of the Vallornguard was celebrated. The Navarr Assembly accepted the coming fall of the Ossegrahn wards in Therunin, and Nathair Autumngale challenged his own position as Advisor on the Vallorn.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn Assembly urged citizens to protect the coming construction of the Great Port of Calvos in Madruga and to remember the nation's seers. The Assembly of Nine condemned Aunty Hem for dedication to Freedom and asked that a Freeborn carry out any death sentence.
n.The League: A League mandate created a ten-throne-a-season bequest to the Vallornguard, drawing investment away from the Blood Red Quays galleries, museum and theatre. League bishops urged citizens to turn away the Falconer's cult in Temeschwar and to keep away from the Sarcophan cathedral in Sarvos.
n.The Marches: Marcher artisans were mandated to send ten wains of mithril to the Navarri army, delaying any Marcher runeforge for four seasons. The assembly raised hue and cry against the Agramant cultist Alf Alwen and sought legal recognition for the role of Reeves.
n.Thule: A veto of the Thule treaty failed by 102 votes to 1956, and an exaltation of the Thule treaty's negotiator Kindra Surefoot was not upheld. Separately, the Varushkan Assembly urged Varushkans living under Thule control to come south.
n.Urizen: The Urizen Assembly revoked Octavius of the White Citadel as War Mage and urged study of the influence of Sung and Ylenwe over Spiral. It also warned that Druj infiltrators would hide among Sarangrave refugees.
n.Varushka: Varushkan artisans were mandated to equip the new Navarri army, so Varushka cannot begin a runeforge for four seasons. The assembly castigated the Falconer's cult and called on Varushkans under Thule rule to return south.
n.Wintermark: The Wintermark Assembly sought a site for the Forge of Bonds and urged a search of the sacred swamps for Isenbrad's resting place. It also called heroes to root out the Falconer's cult from the Suaq Wastes and mandated that the faithful take false auras to the Stormcrows.

t.Hercynia: Mithril from Dawn, the Marches and Varushka, and the Ethengraw's forges, were all directed to raising the Third Navarr army in Hercynia. The Navarr Assembly also warned that the Falconer's cult was seeking to spread there.
t.Kallavesa: The Wintermark Assembly welcomed the Meeting Place being built in Kallavesa as a chance for the Ghodi and the mystics to share ideas. The territory was also the scene of a hunt for the cultist Jem Bribban and of the newly completed Custodian of Bones sinecure.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 4 crowns to the Virtue Fund.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 2 crowns to the Virtue Fund.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 3 crowns to the Virtue Fund.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 2 thrones to the Virtue Fund.
t.Upwold: The Marcher Assembly invited the Faraden to break ground on the Yakholme Grange trade enclave in Upwold, asking that theological debate be left to priests. It also warned Marchers that the Heralds of Tharim were abroad there hunting Jem Bribban and Alf Alwen.

r.Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh: The Dream-of-Famine cultist Jem Bribban had gone to ground in the fogs of Kallavesa Marsh. The Wintermark Assembly asked Winterfolk for any rumour, omen or dream that might lead heroes to them.
r.Kallavesa/Skymark: Captain Raal Sealspeaker completed the Custodian of Bones sinecure in Skymark, paying for the dolmen Rikkivesi himself. Under it the hylje will recover the bones and valuables of Imperial Orcs who fell during the Jotun invasion of Sermersuaq.

387YE Summer Solstice event schedule.d: Senator elections were held in each nation's camp on Saturday afternoon, from Urizen's demos at 1pm to the League's presentation of bonds at 3:30pm. Tally of the Votes elections followed from 3:30pm to 5:30pm for the Marches, Urizen, the Brass Coast, Varushka, Highguard, the League, Dawn and Navarr. Some of these titles were marked as having their next regular election at a later summit. The timetable also listed Senate, Sun Chamber, Conclave, Military Council, Synod, Bourse, Academy and militia sessions and their deadlines. Other entries included battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday, a parley with Hayaak, a delegation from Tharim and the Imperial Economics Conference.

n.Dawn: Dawn elected a senator for Weirwater at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney. It chose its Reeve of Drycastle and Warden of the Weary in Glory Square at 5:30pm, and a Dawnish Fleet Captains' Meeting was held on Saturday afternoon.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named in the schedule. The Feroz senator election it lists is assigned to the Brass Coast camp.
n.Highguard: Highguard began its inquisition of Bastion's senatorial candidates at 2pm. At 4:30pm in the Chapel it elected the Vigilant Swan, Cinderpath Custodian, Golden Fleet Salvagemaster, Exarch of Virtue's Rest and Steward of the Ossuary.
n.Navarr: Navarr elected Miaren's senator at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing. It chose the Broker of Treji Wayhouse at the Standing Circle at 5:30pm.
n.The League: The League elected senators for both Sarvos and Spiral at 3:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds. It then elected the Northbound Trademaster, Keeper of the Tome and Vardstein Vandal at the Plaza at 5pm.
n.The Marches: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect Mitwold's senator. At 3:30pm in the Community Hall the nation chose its Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange and Bailiff of the Grand Market.
n.Urizen: Urizen held a demos from 1pm to 1:30pm to elect Redoubt's senator. It elected the Quaymaster of the Elosian Docks and Architect of the Crucible near the Net of Heaven at 3:30pm, and a Urizen Magician's Meeting took place on Friday evening.
n.Varushka: Varushka began questioning Karov's senatorial candidates at 1:45pm. At 4pm at the Central Hearth it elected the Granites of Veltsgorsk, Boyar of the Iron Roads, Burgher of Ketsov and Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark elected Sermersuaq's senator at 2pm, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes. No Wintermark titles were listed for the Tally of the Votes.

t.Bastion: Bastion's senator was chosen by a Highguard inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.
t.Feroz: The schedule listed a senator election for Feroz at 2pm, run by auction in the Brass Coast camp.
t.Karov: Karov's senator was elected after a questioning of candidates in the Varushkan camp beginning at 1:45pm.
t.Miaren: Miaren's senator was elected at 1:15pm in the Navarr camp, immediately after the standing.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold's senator was elected at 1:30pm when the Marcher landowners gathered.
t.Redoubt: Redoubt's senator was elected by a Urizen demos running from 1pm to 1:30pm.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos's senator was elected at 3:30pm through the League's presentation of collected bonds.
t.Sermersuaq: Sermersuaq's senator was elected at 2pm in the Wintermark camp, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes.
t.Spiral: Spiral's senator was elected alongside Sarvos's at 3:30pm through the League's presentation of collected bonds.
t.Weirwater: Weirwater's senator was elected at 2:30pm in the Dawnish camp, immediately after the tourney.

r.Spiral/Ossuary: The Steward of the Ossuary was listed for election by Highguard's Tally of the Votes at 4:30pm in the Chapel. A note records that the title's next regular election falls at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

387YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: The Quartermaster General limited the 150-throne Imperial Guerdon to units supporting the Autumn Hammers and Northern Eagle. Marcher and Imperial Orc units could escort the 272-bond Southern Herd from Mareave towards Highguard. Marcher and Wintermark fleets could help the Red Wind Corsairs become a navy, and congregations gained special lectures on Capodomus, Faraden and the Spiral mystagogues. Magical effects included the Silver Magician raising a peak in Occursion, Rivers of Life over Mournwold, Hammers of Fury on Karov and Redoubt, Guardian Gate on the Court of the White Fountain, several regional fortification rituals, a lingering Penumbral Veil over much of the Empire, and a Summer light display over Feroz.

n.Dawn: Heralds of Swiftwind spur Dawnish questing knights and knights-errant to Glory until the Autumn Equinox. Units supporting Knights of Glory-enchanted armies from Astolat earn a golden apple, while Astolat, Weirwater and Semmerholm lie under the Penumbral Veil.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but an Imperial coven raised a wooden fastness in Nesustak Forest in Druj-held Sarangrave.
n.Grendel: A Summer-magic display of dancing light creatures, featuring an Urizen changeling and a Navarr man, repeats in the night sky over Grendel-held Feroz, and fortification rituals were cast on Mareave regions the Grendel share with the Imperial Orcs.
n.Highguard: Bastion and Reikos remain under the Penumbral Veil, Navarr are encouraged to settle in Reikos via the Micah's Stand wayhouse, and the Southern Herd should reach Highguard next season if enough soldiers escort it.
n.Imperial Orcs: Imperial Orc units may guard the Southern Herd out of Mareave, League congregations can help recover the bones of orcs who died at Solen's Doubt, and Mareave regions were strengthened with Basalt and Frozen Citadel rituals.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: Marcher and Wintermark fleet owners who want to play out raiding the Jotun along the Gullet are pointed to other actions, as the Assault the Kongegőr only opens when the Red Wind Corsairs take to the sea.
n.Navarr: The Micah's Stand wayhouse in High Chalcis lets Navarr settle in Reikos free of the usual cost and still vote as if in Therunin. Miaren and Hercynia lie under the Penumbral Veil.
n.The Brass Coast: Segura remains under the Penumbral Veil, and the Ashen Flame coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Braydon's Jasse in Kahraman.
n.The League: All five League cities lie under the Penumbral Veil, and Spiral congregations can protect the mystagogues on the bone pilgrimage. Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato put forward Hand of the Dhomiro for Imperial lore.
n.The Marches: Marcher units may escort the Southern Herd, and Marcher fleets can help the Red Wind Corsairs assault the Kongegőr after Fredegar Bloodmouth's judgement. Rivers of Life now blesses Mournwold, two covens raised wooden fastnesses in Alderly, and Marcher fleets gain a bonus trading at Caitun.
n.Urizen: Redoubt is under Hammers of Fury to speed a new army's mustering, Storms End enchanted the Court of the White Fountain with Guardian Gate, and the Silver Magician is raising a great peak in Occursion in Zenith.
n.Varushka: The Lyktan coven's Hammers of Fury speed a new army's mustering in Karov, trading mine ingots for Autumn vis, while every other Varushkan territory lies under the Penumbral Veil.
n.Wintermark: After Hadrick Hardin's judgement, Wintermark fleets can help the Red Wind Corsairs assault the Kongegőr, and they gain a bonus trading at Caitun. Hahnmark and Sermersuaq remain under the Penumbral Veil.

t.Astolat: Units supporting Knights of Glory-enchanted armies that started the season in Astolat gain a golden apple of Summer vis, and the territory remains under the Penumbral Veil.
t.Bastion: Bastion remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Feroz: A repeating Summer-magic apparition fills the night sky: a chained bag unlocked by an Urizen changeling and a Navarr man bursts into dancing creatures of light.
t.Hahnmark: Hahnmark remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Hercynia: Hercynia remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Holberg: Holberg remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Kahraman: The Ashen Flame coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in the region of Braydon's Jasse.
t.Karov: Hammers of Fury speeds the mustering of a new army in Karov, while its mines yield two fewer ingots but each gains a pawn of Autumn vis. Karov is the only Varushkan territory outside the Penumbral Veil.
t.Karsk: Karsk remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Mareave: The 272-bond Southern Herd gathered here waits for Marcher and Imperial Orc escorts. A Basalt Citadel was raised in Eoradal and a Frozen Citadel in Clisearn.
t.Miaren: Miaren remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Miekarova: Miekarova remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Mournwold: The Sails of the First Flame wove Rivers of Life over Mournwold, healing wounds, filling its water with Spring power and easing army losses. Two covens raised wooden fastnesses in Alderly.
t.Ossium: Ossium remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Redoubt: Hammers of Fury speeds the mustering of a new army here, trading mine ingots for Autumn vis, and the Court of the White Fountain's Guardian Gate lets its defenders report hostile spies and armies.
t.Reikos: The newly completed Micah's Stand wayhouse in High Chalcis invites Navarr to settle in Reikos, and the territory remains under the Penumbral Veil.
t.Sarangrave: The Coven of the Horned Hare raised a wooden fastness in Nesustak Forest.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

t.Tassato: Tassato remains under the Penumbral Veil, and Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato raised Hand of the Dhomiro for Imperial lore.
t.Temeschwar: Temeschwar remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.The Barrens: The Phoenix Rising coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Hope's Rest.
t.Therunin: Navarr who settle in Reikos through Micah's Stand still count as being in Therunin for senatorial and similar elections.
t.Volodmartz: Volodmartz remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.
t.Weirwater: Weirwater remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

r.Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse: The Ashen Flame coven cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Braydon's Jasse.
r.Mareave/Clisearn: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Clisearn.

r.Mournwold/Alderly: Both the Sails of the First Flame and the Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly.
r.Redoubt/Willstone: Mentioned in passing: only in the name of Lucius Ankarien Willstone, who raised and funded Gardener's Wheel for Imperial lore.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Nesustak Forest.
r.The Barrens/Hope's Rest: The Phoenix Rising coven cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Hope's Rest.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The winds included an Imperial address by Emperor Vesna and new armies for Highguard and Varushka. Navarr committed itself to war on the vallorn, and the new Magpies and Vallornguard sodalities were launched. There were appraisals of the Forest of Ulnak and the Bay of Catazar lighthouses, plans to dam the River Doubt in Spiral, and diplomacy with Jarm, the Commonwealth, Axos, Faraden, Asavea, Sumaah and the Sarcophan Delves. Other notices covered Big Icebarn in the Suaq Wastes, the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine, the Southern Herd reaching Mareholm, and the completed Great Hall of Fabric Arts and Library of Worth. They also reported killings at Dunfrith and twenty-nine Spring conjunction outcomes, including halting a Jotun advance in Ottermire.

n.Dawn: Dawn's Free Folk, former Asavean slaves now living as yeofolk, set out for Anvil to see Lady Eleanor Novarion honoured. The Barrens saw a failed exorcism at Hope's Rest and an unclear tournament in the Untrod Groves.
n.Druj: The Senate's appraisal of the Forest of Ulnak sought ways to disrupt Druj operations and supply. The conjunction to influence the vallorn at Mirereach in Druj-held Bendol was not taken.
n.Grendel: The Empire negotiated with part of the Grendel, and an infiltrated Grendel espionage ring in Apulian offered a chance to play the players at their own game. A Grendel captain was also interrogated in Uccelini.
n.Highguard: The return of the grey pilgrims let Highguard raise a fourth army bearing hallowed banners, and its senator was still to choose the army's quality. Highborn priests looked for ways to bolster the nation's campaigns.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Library of Worth in Skarsind was completed, and the Weigher of Worth could now choose a word and symbol each summit. Nine orc warbands escorted the Southern Herd, funded largely by orc cattle bonds, to Mareholm.
n.Jotun: The Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet in Ottermire was stopped, and Einar the Cunning and Carmo Stoneblade were killed. However, the Jotun garrison of Grismont Township in Bastasor held.
n.Navarr: Navarr called its stridings home and committed everything to fighting the vallorn. It now faced the urgent task of funding its new army and persuading the rest of the Empire that the time to fight had come.
n.The Brass Coast: Velasco i Guerra led the attempt to seize Grismont Township in Reinos, which failed to defeat the garrison. In Burnish, nine new constellations were drawn, named and given lore.
n.The League: The League was concerned with the planned Apstrus dam, intrigue and Night magic in Apulian, the Vallornguard, and League citizens' appeal to the Constitutional Court over the Empire's finances.
n.The Marches: Amberlain P. Black of the Marches led the battle that stopped the Jotun in Ottermire, and Corazón pennants were presented to the Marcher egregore. Stanley of Chalkdown killed Einar the Cunning in Alderly, and Marcher orcs were to be rescued.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the diplomacy round-up notes peace treaties with the Thule.
n.Urizen: Urizen is named alongside Varushka as a nation that accepts only Synod mandates passed with a greater majority, and Wintermark has now joined them. Two Urizen conjunctions succeeded: the Ward of the Black Waste in Altis and the ilium retrieval in Iteri.
n.Varushka: Varushka's third army was ready to march, though its quality and name remained undecided. The Great Hall of Fabric Arts in Delev was completed, and the Ketsov family withdrew their support from the Burgher of Ketsov.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark joined Varushka and Urizen in accepting only Synod mandates passed with a greater majority. Over four thousand Winterfolk hunted alongside Big Icebarn, and killings at Dunfrith called for the Guardian of Dunfrith to investigate.

t.Bay of Catazar: The bay was the focus of an appraisal proposing to refurbish the Celesti Lighthouse and survey other great lighthouses. The Rhianos Great Race that began with a sponsored race around the bay reached its conclusion.
t.Bregasland: The Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet was stopped and the greenteeth of Drowner's Dell were killed. Plundered Lasambrians were returned to Sallow, and yegarra withdrew back into Bregasland from Mitwold.
t.Casinea: The Southern Herd of two hundred and seventy-two cows arrived safely in Mareholm, a few days' walk from Anvil.
t.Feroz: Mentioned in passing: citizens of Feroz are listed among those with an interest in the Sound and vision wind of magic.
t.Forest of Ulnak: Mladen Escovitch delivered his appraisal of the forest, setting out proposals for disrupting Druj operations and supply.
t.Hahnmark: Missing livestock, damage and three deaths at the village of Dunfrith prompted a conjunction for the Guardian of Dunfrith to investigate. Hahnmark farmers were also tagged in the Sarcophan wind.
t.Hercynia: The Great Library of Hacynian was consecrated to Wisdom with true liao, inspiring visitors and granting the Singer of the Silence new abilities.
t.Holberg: Faraden sought to establish a Faraden Quarter in Holberg. At Sacrifice Point some greenteeth were killed, but the rest fled into Misericorde.
t.Kallavesa: Bandits were killed at Whittling Grove and yegarra defeated at Hufi's Glen. A new Meeting Place was commissioned after the Imperial Consul met the ghodi on Gull Isle.
t.Karov: Mentioned in passing: Karov is not named on the page, and is linked only through the wider Varushkan matters it reports.
t.Mareave: Plans to dam the River Doubt aimed to relieve Icarion's aridity. The Southern Herd needed a fifteen-hundred-strength escort to reach Mareave through Spiral.
t.Miaren: Mentioned in passing: the Eternal Flame of Miaren is tagged as interested in Navarr's war against the vallorn.
t.Miekarova: Mentioned in passing: Vaclav Mladenovich Kosti, now Senator for Miekarova, received the Sorrowful Tunnels research, and the senator is tagged in a wind of magic.
t.Mitwold: The Bailiff of Meade's attempt to defeat yegarra at John's Holt cost Imperial casualties, though the yegarra withdrew into Bregasland.
t.Morrow: The Archmage of Winter successfully performed the Ward of the Black Waste in the Canticulous Valley in Altis.
t.Mournwold: Einar the Cunning was killed and the Jotun defeated at Boar's Hall in Alderly. Sleepers in Mournwold are also mentioned in a wind of magic.
t.Necropolis: Mentioned in passing: sleepers in Necropolis are listed among those concerned by the Sound and vision wind.
t.Ossium: The Ketsov family of Ossium withdrew their support from the Burgher of Ketsov title, and wreckers were defeated at Makgore's Grove.
t.Otkodov: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov's affairs fall under the diplomacy round-up, and the Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged in it and in the Faraden wind.
t.Reinos: The Imperial attempt to seize Grismont Township failed, though Pastor Ximena was captured and released and Nergui Enkhtseg killed. Carmo Stoneblade was slain at Carmo's Sheepfold.
t.Sarangrave: The Emperor's address concerned the assault into Sarangrave. The Mirereach conjunction was not taken, leaving Sarangrave unconnected to the trods.
t.Sarvos: Eilian Sweetwater convened the lighthouse symposium at Sarvos, and cadets interrogated a Grendel captain at Smugglers Copse with unclear results.
t.Segura: Imperial heroes at the Meadow of Dust and Glass in Burnish created, named and gave lore to nine new constellations.
t.Sermersuaq: Big Icebarn continued hunting monsters in the Suaq Wastes, and a body was investigated at Njord Beach Hut in Stark with uncertain findings.
t.Skarsind: The Library of Worth was completed and the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine in Gildermark could now be built. Cultists were killed at Osweald, while a bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones had an uncertain outcome.
t.Spiral: Progress continued on damming the River Doubt in Apstrus, and Apulian was gripped by Night magic and Grendel intrigue. The Southern Herd needed escort through the territory.
t.Tassato: Wreckers, including Maurizia Spada di Sarvos, were killed at Lucrezia's Orchard in Madeiras. Sleepers in Tassato are also mentioned in a wind of magic.
t.The Barrens: The attempt to exorcise tortured souls at Hope's Rest failed with casualties, and the outcome of the Earl of the Groves' tournament was unclear.
t.Therunin: The Lord of Thorns was killed and the Sprig of Fecundity recovered, a miasma pillar was destroyed, and the Axou warrior Menoetius was rescued.
t.Zenith: The Warmage defeated wreckers in Iteri, retrieving the ilium and killing Tuomas of Pirenea. Citizens of Zenith are tagged in a wind of magic.

r.Bregasland/Grey Fens: The Keeper of the Breadbasket's band killed all the greenteeth at Drowner's Dell.
r.Bregasland/Ottermire: Under Field Marshal Amberlain P. Black the Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet was stopped. Corazón pennants were claimed, bounds were beaten and the Strong Reeds inspired.
r.Bregasland/The Rushes: The General of the Strong Reeds recovered the plundered goods at Sallow's Shallows, returning the Lasambrians to Sallow.
r.Casinea/Mareholm: The Southern Herd arrived safely in Mareholm, and needed a fifteen-hundred-strength escort to continue through Spiral to Mareave.
r.Holberg/Misericorde: At Sacrifice Point some greenteeth were killed, but the rest fled into Misericorde.
r.Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh: The Woundbinder of the Mark's band defeated the yegarra at Hufi's Glen.
r.Kallavesa/West Marsh: The Imperial Consul met the ghodi on Gull Isle; the outcome was unclear, but a new Meeting Place was commissioned.
r.Kallavesa/Wittal Grove: The Strategos of Wintermark's band intercepted and killed bandits at Whittling Grove.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: Mentioned in passing: Beoraidh appears in the diplomacy table, with its affairs covered by the I wish you would wind.
r.Mareave/Icarion: Plans to dam the River Doubt in Apstrus aim to relieve Icarion's aridity, though some issues remain before work can proceed.
r.Mitwold/Meade March: The Bailiff of Meade's band suffered casualties at John's Holt, though the yegarra withdrew back to Bregasland.
r.Morrow/Altis: The Archmage of Winter successfully performed the Ward of the Black Waste in the Canticulous Valley.
r.Mournwold/Alderly: Stanley of Chalkdown's band killed Einar the Cunning at Boar's Hall and defeated the Jotun.
r.Ossium/Drownbark Forest: The Cabalist of the Hollow Stone's band defeated the wreckers at Makgore's Grove.
r.Reinos/Bastasor: Velasco i Guerra's force failed to defeat the Grismont Township garrison but captured and safely released Pastor Ximena and killed Nergui Enkhtseg. Fewer than a dozen Imperials joined the Balankas Rush.
r.Reinos/Pedreira: The Champion of Prosperity sought to recover Bulangiin Karadghra at Getshold, with an unclear outcome.
r.Reinos/Ribeira: The General of the Summer Storm's band killed Carmo Stoneblade at Carmo's Sheepfold and defeated his warband.
r.Sarangrave/Bendol: The major conjunction to influence the vallorn at Mirereach was not taken, so Sarangrave remains unconnected to the trods.
r.Sarvos/Uccelini: The Cadet Commander's band interrogated a Grendel captain at Smugglers Copse; the cadets should know the results.
r.Segura/Burnish: At the Meadow of Dust and Glass, nine constellations were drawn and named, and lore and mythology were created for them.
r.Sermersuaq/Stark: The Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind investigated a body at Njord Beach Hut, with uncertain findings.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: Some four thousand Winterfolk hunted monsters alongside Big Icebarn. It will remain another season if supported by at least six thousand strength of Wintermark military units.
r.Skarsind/Gildermark: Research on the Sorrowful Tunnels was completed, and a mithril mine there could now be commissioned. The upper tunnels would yield eighteen wains of mithril a season, or twenty-seven with the lower tunnels excavated too.
r.Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass: A cult's vanguard was intercepted and killed at Osweald, while Alistair de Vere's bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones had an uncertain outcome.
r.Spiral/Apstrus: Real progress was made on the proposed dam across the River Doubt, and Amity was granted to the eternal Ylenwe, though some matters remain unresolved.
r.Spiral/Apulus: The Voice of Vigilance met followers of Berechiah in the Cellar Below, with uncertain results.
r.Tassato/Madeiras: Wreckers were killed at Lucrezia's Orchard, including Maurizia Spada di Sarvos.
r.The Barrens/Hope's Rest: The High Exorcist's band suffered casualties and exorcised no tortured souls, which have gathered around the Shrine of Hope.
r.The Barrens/The Untrod Groves: Enchanter Morien de Carsenere attended the Earl of the Groves' tournament at Tournament Square, with unclear results.
r.Therunin/Eastring: Blaze Dunning's band destroyed the miasma pillar at the Tainted Meadow.
r.Therunin/Peakedge Song: The Eastern Broker's band rescued the Axou warrior Menoetius at Catrin's Glade.
r.Therunin/Sweetglades: The Champion of Vigilance's band killed the Lord of Thorns at Broken Copse and recovered the Sprig of Fecundity.
r.Zenith/Iteri: The Warmage's band defeated wreckers in Lutum Woods, retrieved the ilium and killed Tuomas of Pirenea.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Five conflicts received their own Wind of War pages. Prognosticators identified four possible Sentinel Gate battles, two of which the generals would choose at the Military Council muster. Two were against the Jotun, at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and Far Steading in Liathaven. Two were against the Druj, at the Palace Expanse in Sarangrave and the Plantation of Tall Ferns in Zenith. Nations' force weights were listed, with Wintermark, Dawn and Navarr the largest. Conjunctions across the Empire pitted Imperial citizens against Jotun, Druj, Grendel, cultists, heralds and other threats, and offered peaceful errands. The page also restated special army orders, territorial bonuses and Druj beachhead thresholds.

n.Dawn: Dawn brought 58 force weight, and its armies still could not take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders. Citizens patrolling the Barrens forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead there, and the Keeper of the Last Battle was called to fight Druj and heralds of Arhallogen in the Bleaks.
n.Druj: The Druj were the opposition in the proposed battles in Sarangrave and Zenith and in several conjunctions in Therunin, Zenith and the Barrens. Border patrols meant they needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in the Barrens, Morrow, Zenith or Ossium.
n.Grendel: Imperial heroes were sent to defeat the Grendel and claim a cache at Halkrin's Orchard in Fleisardh. Separately, the Ambassador to the Grendel was called to meet a visiting Grendel wind lord at the Black Sand Tower in Beoraidh.
n.Highguard: Highguard fielded 23 force weight. Highborn armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow against attack from Zenith, retained their bonuses, and the Champion of Pride was asked to lead against servants of the Red God in the Necropolis.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs contributed only 5 force weight but kept the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind. The Shepherd of the Great Herd was named to deal with cultists in Mormyk Woods, Estermark.
n.Jotun: The Jotun were the enemy in the proposed battles at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and Far Steading in Liathaven. They also faced conjunctions against their yegarra, against Halbera Strongarm and around a construct in Liathaven, while Wintermark armies kept their honour-bound modifiers against them.
n.Navarr: Navarr fielded 55 force weight. Its lands saw conjunctions in Miaren to ease the passing of ghosts and in Therunin against Druj and heralds, and its conflict in Therunin and Liathaven continued.
n.The Marches: The Marches fielded 28 force weight, and its armies could not Give Ground. Its home armies gained extra strength in their own territories, any Imperial army could Billet across Marcher lands, and conjunctions in Mournwold targeted yegarra and Ulvenwar.
n.Urizen: Urizen fielded 12 force weight. Patrols in Morrow and Zenith raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points, Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow kept their bonus, and the Champion of Vigilance was named to fight the Druj at Danwyn's Path in Zenith.
n.Varushka: Varushka fielded 16 force weight. Patrols in Ossium raised the Druj beachhead threshold there, Varushkan armies kept the Hospitality of the Boyars order in Ossium, and the Senator for Miekarova was called to fight cultists in Mieriada.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark fielded the largest force weight at 62. Its armies kept the Fight with Honour order and their modifiers against the Jotun, and conjunctions in Sermersuaq, Hahnmark and Kallavesa called on Winterfolk title-holders.

t.Bay of Catazar: The uncontrolled Bay of Catazar was the subject of its own Wind of War, Long grass and stormclouds.
t.Bregasland: Jotun-held Bregasland featured in the Shovels and spades Wind of War and offered a proposed battle to kill a guardian at Cinder Drove. Cadets were sent to rescue magicians in Ottermire, Imperial armies could Billet there, and the Strong Reeds gained 1000 strength fighting there.
t.Brocéliande: The Speaker of the Vallornguard was named to lead 80 heroes against a cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade in the Vallorn-held forest.
t.Hahnmark: Hahnmark saw two conjunctions: an investigation into trouble at Dunfrith in Wood Heath, and a fight against cultists at Dunhall Copse in Valasmark.
t.Kallavesa: The Crow Keeper of the Rest was asked to lead a small band against coral husks at Mjod's Glen in Kallavesa Marsh.
t.Liathaven: Contested Liathaven had its own Wind of War, Axe-bite and ploughshare, and a proposed battle to destroy a Jotun mechanism at Far Steading. Three Friday conjunctions targeted Halbera Strongarm, heralds at Sigryn's Bawn and a construct at Freydi's Meadow.
t.Mareave: Mareave hosted conjunctions to defeat the Courath of Icarion and to defeat the Grendel and claim a cache in Fleisardh. A meeting with a visiting Grendel wind lord was also arranged at the Black Sand Tower.
t.Miaren: The Eternal Flame of Miaren was called to lead up to 100 people in easing the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site.
t.Miekarova: The Senator for Miekarova was named to lead a small force against cultists at the Painted Clearing in Mieriada.
t.Mitwold: Imperial armies could take the Billet order in Mitwold, and the Drakes gained 1000 strength fighting there.
t.Morrow: Citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead in Morrow. Highborn and Urizen armies defending Morrow against attack from Zenith, or attacking from it into Zenith, kept their bonuses.
t.Mournwold: Mournwold featured in the Shovels and spades Wind of War, with conjunctions against yegarra at Warthill Woods and two against the Ulvenwar in Greensward. Armies could Billet there, and the Tusks gained 1000 strength fighting there.
t.Necropolis: The Champion of Pride was named to lead heroes against servants of the Red God at the Broken Grove in Coursmouth.
t.Ossium: Citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead in Ossium, and Varushkan armies could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order there.
t.Sarangrave: Sarangrave was covered by the Root and branch Wind of War and offered a proposed battle against the Druj to break an enchantment at the Palace Expanse in Kroll. A conjunction also aimed to claim Vate's Shelter in Bendol.
t.Sermersuaq: The Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq was named to lead 60 heroes to kill Typhawn at Typhawn's Pen in the Suaq Wastes.
t.Skallahn: Eerikki Korpi was named to lead a small group into the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King.
t.Skarsind: Imperial Orc armies could take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind, and a conjunction was set to defeat cultists in Mormyk Woods, Estermark.
t.The Barrens: Patrols in the Barrens forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead, and the Keeper of the Last Battle was called to kill Druj and heralds of Arhallogen in the Bleaks.
t.Therunin: Therunin had its own Wind of War, Willow and rain. Three conjunctions were set there: a peaceful visit to bask in the lantern at Glimmerwater, and fights against the Druj in Greenheart and against heralds and Druj at the Toxic Sward.
t.Upwold: Imperial armies could take the Billet order in Upwold, and the Bounders gained 1000 strength fighting there.
t.Zenith: Contested Zenith was covered by the Root and branch Wind of War and offered a proposed battle to poison the sac at the Plantation of Tall Ferns. A conjunction against the Druj was set at Danwyn's Path, and patrols and attack bonuses from Morrow still applied.

r.Bregasland/Ottermire: Cadets were sent to rescue magicians at Picklers Marsh.
r.Bregasland/The Rushes: A proposed battle against the Jotun aimed to kill the guardian at Cinder Drove.
r.Brocéliande/Dark Ranging: Up to 80 heroes were sent to kill a cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade.
r.Hahnmark/Valasmark: The Senator for Hahnmark was named to lead a fight against cultists at Dunhall Copse.
r.Hahnmark/Wood Heath: The Guardian of Dunfrith was asked to investigate the source of trouble at Dunfrith.
r.Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh: A small band was sent to defeat coral husks at Mjod's Glen.
r.Liathaven/Liath's Ring: The Champion of Ambition was named to lead 65 heroes against heralds at Sigryn's Bawn.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: The General of the Autumn Hammers was named to recover a construct at Freydi's Meadow.
r.Liathaven/West Ranging: A proposed battle aimed to destroy a Jotun mechanism at Far Steading, and a conjunction sought to kill Halbera Strongarm at Halbera's Stockade.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: The Ambassador to the Grendel was called to meet a visiting Grendel wind lord at the Black Sand Tower.
r.Mareave/Fleisardh: The Champion of Prosperity was named to lead 70 heroes against the Grendel at Halkrin's Orchard to claim a cache.
r.Mareave/Icarion: The General of the Citadel Guard was named to defeat the Courath of Icarion at the Courath's Hold.
r.Miaren/Serenael: Up to 100 people were called to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site.
r.Miekarova/Mieriada: A small force was sent to defeat cultists at the Painted Clearing.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: Two small conjunctions, at Honour's Rest Fields and the Farstrider Approach, aimed to kill the Ulvenwar.
r.Mournwold/Southmoor: Jedediah Boon was named to lead 60 heroes against the yegarra at Warthill Woods.
r.Necropolis/Coursmouth: Heroes were sent to kill servants of the Red God at the Broken Grove.
r.Sarangrave/Bendol: The Knight of the Greenwood was named to claim Vate's Shelter at Ghulai's Rest.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: A proposed battle against the Druj aimed to break an enchantment at the Palace Expanse.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: Heroes were sent to kill Typhawn at Typhawn's Pen.
r.Skallahn/Fareskov: A small group was to enter the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King.
r.Skarsind/Estermark: The Shepherd of the Great Herd was named to defeat cultists in Mormyk Woods.
r.The Barrens/The Bleaks: Heroes were called to kill Druj and heralds of Arhallogen at Last Battle's Field.
r.Therunin/Eastring: Eanna Glimmerwater was named for a peaceful visit to bask in the lantern at Glimmerwater, while the Champion of Wisdom was to fight heralds and Druj at the Toxic Sward.
r.Therunin/Greenheart: The Spear of the Seven was named to lead 70 heroes against the Druj in the Untrod Wilds.
r.Zenith/Lustri: The Champion of Vigilance was named to defeat the Druj at Danwyn's Path.
r.Zenith/Proceris: A proposed battle against the Druj aimed to poison the sac at the Plantation of Tall Ferns.

A better future.d: The Prince Mila School of the Belligerent Art, a Maykop–Jarm collaboration, was closed after Fintan Nighthaven's protest. Axos blamed Maxatios, though the civil service judged him a scapegoat and Skopos a likely ally of Grand Ilarch Kyther's unity movement. Several sects formed a Unified Convocation at Solokha. Kantor now trades Sable and Blackened Key instead of orichalcum, and Issyk has reopened to Imperial fleets with Axou esoterica. Maykop offered the Conclave a chance to codify a Winter ritual. Further items were a request for students to visit the Great Library of Hacynian, a visiting memory-doctor, two missing merchants, and an Ipotavo emissary seeking General Gabriel Barossa.

n.Druj: The Druj had captured the Axou agema Menoetius of Issyk to make him a tortured soul, but Imperial heroes rescued him. Fintan Nighthaven's assurance that the Empire means to destroy the Druj was warmly received in Axos.
n.Highguard: Mentioned in passing: the House of Spirits in Highguard-held Casinea is run by Mistress Isephenia of Maykop and Rinnah of the Shattered Tower, the Bursar of the House of Spirits.
n.Navarr: Fintan Nighthaven of Navarr, the Ambassador to Axos, exposed the treaty breach and was publicly thanked by the Grand Council for his advice. He also promised that Therunin would be recovered from the Druj.

t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: Casinea is home to the House of Spirits, run by Mistress Isephenia and the Bursar Rinnah, whose students now seek a season at the Great Library of Hacynian.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Mentioned in passing: Fintan Nighthaven assured Axos that the Salt Flats of Sanath would one day be freed from the Buruk Tepel.
t.Sarangrave: Mentioned in passing: Fintan Nighthaven assured Axos that the Sarangrave would one day be freed from the Buruk Tepel.
t.Therunin: Mentioned in passing: Fintan Nighthaven told Axos that the Empire would recover Therunin from the Druj.

A thousand steps.d: Only Highguard, the League and Varushka agreed that the time was right to fight the vallorn. With the treasury empty, the Navarr had to fund their Hercynian army themselves, using mithril or various ingots and measures. The options were these: send Navarr military units into Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, boosted by Feast of Heroes and three Heroes Helms made by Treji artisans. Other nations could pass Synod mandates committing their artisans. Marrowort could be sold to the City of Gold and Lead at one wain per sixty, at this summit only. Citizens across the Empire could simply be asked for donations. Restless Terunael ghosts were slowing work on the Seren temple.

n.Dawn: Dawn remained broadly unconvinced that now was the time to fight the vallorn, despite clear enthusiasm for a glorious battle against long odds. Its Assembly could commit Dawnish artisans to the Navarr army, worth ten wains, at the cost of being unable to begin a runeforge for four seasons.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: named among the barbarian threats on the Empire's borders that keep the Empire's attention away from the vallorn.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: listed among the barbarian threats on the Empire's borders that keep the Empire's attention away from the vallorn.
n.Highguard: Highguard was one of three nations to agree with the Navarr that the time to fight the vallorn had come. Catrin urged the Navarr to court its wealthy benefactors and the Council of Benefactors, whose ten wains a season could indirectly free funds for the army or support the City of Dreams.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orc Assembly could mandate the Ethengraw of the Black Forge to help raise the Navarr army. This would let the Navarr substitute other resources for mithril more efficiently, but Orc armies would lose the forge hammers order until the army was complete.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: named among the barbarian threats on the Empire's borders, and Jotun-held Liathaven is cited as a place where the vallorn war will not be won.
n.Navarr: With the stridings home and Isaella's Dance sacrificed, the Navarr had only two armies and needed to fund a new one in Hercynia and win allies in the Senate, Military Council and Conclave. Every Navarr was urged to mine Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, sell herbs and marrowort, and beg support from other nations.
n.The League: The League was one of three nations to agree that the time to fight the vallorn was right. Its merchant-princes were named as wealthy targets for Navarr appeals, and Holberg's civic pride as something that might be used to win donations.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: listed among the barbarian threats on the Empire's borders that keep the Empire's attention away from the vallorn.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the Urizeni raising of an army with three hundred wains of mithril in a single season is cited as an example of wealth the Navarr might tap.
n.Varushka: Varushka agreed that the time to fight the vallorn had come. Its Assembly could commit Varushkan artisans to the Navarr army, worth ten wains, at the cost of a year without a new runeforge, and its boyars and wealthy vales were singled out as potential donors.
n.Wintermark: The Wintermark Assembly could mandate the Runegrott artisans to arm the Navarr army, halting new artisan items until the army was complete. However, its upheld statements suggested it saw the vallorn war as ill-timed and a low priority.

t.Brocéliande: Mentioned in passing: Catrin, the broker who urged the Navarr simply to ask every citizen at Anvil for help, came from Brocéliande.
t.Hahnmark: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark is not named on the page; its only link is through the Wintermark Runegrott, whose artisans could be mandated to help arm the Navarr army.
t.Hercynia: The new Navarr army capable of fighting the vallorn was being raised in Hercynia. It could be paid for with mithril or with ingots and measures of weltsilver, orichalcum, green iron, tempest jade, beggar's lye or iridescent gloaming.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: Catrin suggested Holberg's claim to be the greatest city in the world could spur it to outgive other League cities.
t.Liathaven: Mentioned in passing: named in the opening story as one of the places where the vallorn war will not ultimately be won.
t.Miaren: Lorenzo's Deep Pockets on the edge of Miaren offered a seemingly limitless supply of tempest jade and weltsilver for Navarr warbands. The vate Ffion of Parting Ways in Miaren had arranged the marrowort deal with the City of Gold and Lead.
t.Therunin: Mentioned in passing: named in the opening story as a place where the vallorn war will not ultimately be won.

r.Miaren/Serenael: Ghosts of the Terunael city were haunting the Seren temple building site and slowing construction. A conjunction there at 22:45 on the Friday of the Summer Solstice, for a hundred people under Tanwen, the Eternal Flame of Miaren, would let musicians and dancers help the ghosts celebrate and pass into the Labyrinth. Weapons and bloodshed were to be avoided.

An old sodality.d: Founded with the Throne's backing, the Sun Chamber was crippled when nearly all its members died fighting beside Empress Britta. Prompted by Zoria and Luca of the Zulgan Tash, the civil service found its powers were never abrogated. A magnitude 20 Autumn arcane projection was given to Zoria to help members join through Mark of Fellowship, and the Senate chamber was reserved for three sessions covering joining, electing the Counsel and assigning bequests, and using one of the Doors of the Chamber. The court warned that a sodality limiting its membership in this way would struggle to pass scrutiny today. Roshanwe sent three Tempest Jade ammonites so worthy magicians could submit theses to its herald, the Empty Page.

n.The Marches: Mentioned in passing: the opening vignette shows a Marcher-style steading, the Tall Oaks, receiving a letter asking whether their old bequest to the Sun Chamber still stands.

t.Mournwold: Roshanwe's herald, the Empty Page, was to receive the magicians who used the ammonites, along with their guests, in a chamber prepared by the eternal on the edge of Alderly in Mournwold.

r.Mournwold/Alderly: The Eaves, an abandoned woodcutter's hut on the edge of Alderly, was prepared by Roshanwe as the meeting place where its navigators would bring magicians to put their theses to the Empty Page.

Axe-bite and ploughshare.d: Three Wintermark armies, the Autumn Hammers, the Drakes, the Bounders and the Seventh Wave mustered in Green March. Using siege engines leased from Estavus, the Hammers breached Schogsfestnir, and Jarl Sederholm retreated west and began raising a fyrd. The Feni of the Moon-That-Sings supplied maps but insisted Liathaven is now their home. Roughly three thousand Jotun and more than fifteen hundred Imperial soldiers fell. The Wither the Seed curse is gone. Several conjunctions followed, along with a solstice opportunity to destroy an Autumn mechanism hastening the West Ranging fort. Offers from Skathe, Surut and Tharim were also on the table.

n.Highguard: The Seventh Wave scouted ahead, pinned the Schogsfestnir garrison with arrow fire and swept the Glen's flanks. Its general, Melkior of Balthazar's Vineyard, was charged with killing the Jotun champion Halbera Strongarm.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Autumn Hammers brought siege engines leased from the City of Fire and Stone and battered Schogsfestnir open, and Imperial Orc soldiers are now taking up residence there. Ashborn Vana was asked to recover a damaged construct of Estavus.
n.Jotun: The Jotun lost Liaven's Glen, Liath's Ring and Schogsfestnir, with perhaps three thousand dead, but still control Liathaven. Jarl Sederholm is raising a fyrd while a new fortification rises in West Ranging.
n.Navarr: The Empire found the old Navarr steadings gone and the Glen's ancient forest cleared, and Liaven's Dance turned into a guarded Jotun camp, though the earthworks themselves are intact. The vallorn of Liath's Heart remains untouched.
n.The Brass Coast: Mentioned in passing: Kahraman is named as one of the lands bordering Liaven's Glen.
n.The Marches: The Drakes and the Bounders formed the cautious core of the host, joined for the first time by Marcher orc healers on a major campaign abroad. The Bounders received the Feni envoys and their vital maps.
n.Wintermark: The Green Shield, the Bloodcloaks and the Narwhal's Spear fought with conspicuous honour and kept the wounded alive. Champion of Ambition Eldrid Vestardottir was tasked with stopping heralds escorting a construct of Estavus to Westwood.

t.Bregasland: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Host may have been guarding against incursions from Bregasland, Bounders beat its border, and events there prevented a direct attack into Liath's Ring.
t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: its deep woods are compared with the wilder forests of old Liathaven.
t.Hahnmark: Mentioned in passing: its rugged splendour is compared with the once-untamed Liaven's Glen.
t.Kahraman: Mentioned in passing: it is named as bordering Liaven's Glen.
t.Liathaven: The Empire took Liaven's Glen, Liath's Ring and the fortified town of Schogsfestnir, but the Jotun still control the territory. A new Jotun fortification is under construction in West Ranging, and the Feni claim the land as their home.
t.Mournwold: The seven armies mustered in Green March before the invasion, and the Autumn Hammers carried lumber harvested from Alderly.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: its deep woods are compared with the wilder forests of old Liathaven.
t.Reinos: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; it appears only as part of the wider Jotun lands whose armies defended Liathaven.
t.Skallahn: Mentioned in passing: the Autumn mechanism at Far Steading resembles the contraptions once found at the Well of Whispers in Skallahn.
t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: its alpine peaks are contrasted with the woodlands of Liathaven.
t.Tromsa: Mentioned in passing: Igya Olgafsdottir, who built Schogsfestnir, is now Jarl of Tromsa.

r.Liathaven/Liath's Heart: The vallorn heart remains outside both sides' control, ringed by Jotun effigies and rune-poles meant to contain it.
r.Liathaven/Liath's Ring: Using Feni intelligence, Imperial forces cleared the Jotun from the Ring within weeks and consolidated their hold. The armies halted on its western border with West Ranging.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: The Empire stormed and captured the fortified town of Schogsfestnir, the seat of Jarl Sederholm, and took the whole Glen. Many uncertain thralls remain, and Liaven's Dance was found intact.
r.Liathaven/West Ranging: The Jotun fell back here and are hurrying to build a new granite fortification, aided by an Autumn mechanism at Far Steading. Imperial heroes have a solstice opportunity to destroy the device, or Surut offers to burn the region.
r.Liathaven/Westwood: The retreating Jotun are escorting a construct of Estavus to Westwood, where it would resupply the Shield of the Mountain unless Wintermark's Champion of Ambition stops it.
r.Mournwold/Alderly: Mentioned in passing: the Autumn Hammers hauled wagonloads of lumber harvested from its woods.
r.Mournwold/Green March: All seven Imperial armies mustered here before marching west into Liaven's Glen.

Banners and bells.d: Jacob, Benefactor of Regalia, presented banners to the generals of the Granite Pillar, Seventh Wave and Valiant Pegasus, while Ever Forward awaits the new army's general, who could be appointed at the Autumn Equinox. The senator who raised the army must choose a quality: Devoted, Fast or Righteous. For a year, Highborn congregations may forgo liao to support the army against the vallorn. With the crusading storm over, Asher of the Seven Pools proposed a mandate, worded by Exarch Luke, letting Highborn armies Protect the Innocent in the Sarangrave. The Assembly may also invoke peerless kinship each season. The Assembly of Nine appointed Ardeniel of the Woodwych Harts to record the Seven Bells pilgrimage for the Stone Library.

n.Druj: Having lost a large swathe of the Sarangrave to a new Imperial assault, the Druj have spread word of the Barrens slaughter through the Mallum's septs, leaving their oppressed subjects more afraid of the Empire than of their masters.
n.Highguard: Highguard's fourth army can now be raised for 80 mithril around the grey pilgrims and their Ever Forward banner. Its Assembly may also adopt a Protect the Innocent mandate, invoke peerless kinship each season and support the new army against the vallorn.
n.Imperial Orcs: Mentioned in passing: the hallowed bells are described as what the Imperial Orcs would call "items of worth".
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: the grey pilgrims learned to travel the trods alongside the Navarr, which could make the new Highborn army fast like the Black Thorns.

t.Bastion: The Stone Library chapter in Bastion, led by Librarian Seth, challenged the Assembly of Nine to record the Seven Bells pilgrimage. Ardeniel of the Woodwych Harts was appointed, and the chapter's archivists will copy and distribute the account.
t.Sarangrave: The Empire has captured a large swathe of the Sarangrave, with the Granite Pillar ordered to spare the Druj's oppressed subjects. A proposed Highborn mandate would let armies fight there to protect the innocent, though winning over the local septs would be a hard struggle.

Beat of your drum.d: Schöningen praised outgoing ambassador Lucia Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato. She said that once the diplomatenschloss is built, merchants would send seasonal cultural tokens to the ambassador rather than offering "special deals". The Commonwealth is struggling against Jarmish magic in Lantir. It offered Soldatentrunk, Blutlehm, Würzpaste and Heldenstein in return for 200 crystal mana sent by the end of the Summer Solstice. Magicians trapped in the Lyceum improved Rule of Risk and Reward and Sum of the Parts. Professor Gelberg's faculty will auction appraisals at Anvil. The University of Volkavaar asked to acquire a sungold tablet from the Great Library of Hacynian. Schöningen formally questioned whether Suranni serfs are slaves under the Liberty Pact. Teo Freid described orc beliefs about the Raging Storm and reincarnation.

n.Imperial Orcs: Ambassador Pridetalker's enquiry on behalf of some Imperial Orcs drew a reply from Teo Freid. He described a sizeable sect of Commonwealth orcs who believe orcs reincarnate if they resist the Raging Storm through disciplined service to the Common Good.
n.Navarr: Navarr hosts at the Great Library of Hacynian, invited by Advisor on the Vallorn Nathair Autumngale, welcomed the Commonwealth faculty and debated true consecrations with them. They now face a formal request from the University of Volkavaar to name a price for the sungold tablet.
n.The Brass Coast: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn are recalled as having fought alongside Commonwealth soldiers in the fall of Siroc. The Liberty Pact questions arose after a Commonwealth scholar met Iron Confederacy merchants in Madruga.
n.The League: Mentioned in passing: League ambassador Lucia Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato was praised on leaving the post, and the visiting faculty passed through Sarvos, Tassato and Temeschwar.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the city of Seren was among the places the Commonwealth faculty visited on their journey north.
n.Wintermark: Finn Pridetalker of Wintermark was welcomed as the new Ambassador to the Commonwealth. Pridetalker was offered the mana exchange and asked to address the problem of shipping on the Couros.

t.Hercynia: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia is named as the northern end of the Commonwealth faculty's journey from Sarvos.
t.Madruga: While discharging an obligation to Gisli "Provider" Baerson in Madruga, a Commonwealth scholar met Iron Confederacy merchants. That meeting led to the formal Liberty Pact questions about Suranni serfs.
t.Miaren: The Great Library of Hacynian received the Commonwealth faculty and let them study a cracked tablet on making sungold. The University of Volkavaar has now asked what price the Library would accept for it.
t.Redoubt: Mentioned in passing: the city of Seren was visited by the Commonwealth faculty on their travels.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: the Commonwealth faculty were travelling north from Sarvos when the news reached them.
t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: the town of Torfast was among the stops on the Commonwealth faculty's journey.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: the city of Tassato was visited by the Commonwealth faculty, and the former ambassador bears its name.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: the city of Temeschwar was visited by the Commonwealth faculty on their way north.

r.Skarsind/Southpine: Mentioned in passing: the bustling town of Torfast was visited by the Commonwealth faculty on their travels.

Bits and bobs.d: Bourse prices appeared to be falling: the Canterspire Circle sold for 260 thrones, down from 405, and mithril, weirwood and white granite were cheapening. After letters from Else Van Temeschwar and Laurencio di Sarvos and a Vigilance judgement, several options were laid out. The Senate could let the Master of the Mint publish summaries of treasury reports (+5 thrones upkeep). It could commission an appraisal to find tax opportunities. It could relinquish national Bourse seats, though any affected national assembly could veto this. It could abrogate or freeze all ministries, or turn tenured sinecures into annual Bourse auctions. Auditor Gerard La Salle offered to attend Senator Miaren's economics forum.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: the proposal to build a grand lodge for the Golden Pyramid in Grendel's Mareave is cited as an example of an opportunity that raised tax revenue.
n.Navarr: Llewellyn Leafstalker, the Navarr Senator for Miaren, booked the Senate chamber for an economics forum, which the Imperial auditor Gerard La Salle offered to attend to answer questions.
n.The League: League citizens drove the concern, with Else Van Temeschwar and Laurencio di Sarvos writing to the Constitutional Court. The League-held Master of the Mint might gain the power to publish treasury summaries, though any reduction in its status could lower what League citizens pay for the seat.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: the focused appraisal previously carried out on Wintermark's Sermersuaq is cited as an example of how a narrow appraisal can uncover every opportunity.

t.Mareave: Mentioned in passing: the proposal for a Golden Pyramid grand lodge in Mareave is given as an example of an opportunity that boosted a territory's taxation.
t.Miaren: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Miaren, Llewellyn Leafstalker, is hosting an economics forum in the Senate chamber at Anvil.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: the economist Laurencio di Sarvos raised questions with the Constitutional Court, including the estimate of seventy-two tenured sinecures that might be auctioned.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: the earlier appraisal of Sermersuaq is held up as a model of a focused appraisal.
t.Temeschwar: A League Assembly judgement called for trading posts across Temeschwar to turn the Empire's surplus metal into coin, but the page notes such ministries would require an appraisal or extensive diplomacy to achieve.

Can you hear me?.d: Hayaak, now a wandering Outlaw Prince, will parley without boons over whether he has any future with the Empire. The City of Locks offers three meetings through the Conspirator's Congress, chosen by a Declaration of Acceptance, plus a chance to steal the Manticore's favour and an Autumn Market. Janon sends heralds to the Shadowed Torchbearer, the Sun Chamber and others, and offers two ways to inflame Imperial armies. Tharim sends Lord-Captain Catenatus as a formal embassy over Obligatus's murder; his knights are already in Upwold. Kimus aids the Sarvos lighthouse project and the Magpies. Irra Harah will parley but refuses further aid in Therunin and Asav, and sides with the people of the Mallum.

n.Dawn: Irra Harah invites the new general of the Gryphon's Pride to argue for a boon, noting that more Dawnish fought against tyranny than marched on the Rahvin. Dawnish seeking to transform a boon of the Slaughterbeast may also plead their case.
n.Druj: The Empire's campaign in the Sarangrave is Irra Harah's chief concern, and he declares himself on the side of the Mallum's people rather than the Empire's. Imperial armies attacking Kroll face the Lake Beast, and Tharim offers one general protection against it.
n.Imperial Orcs: Janon's heralds wish to discuss the Skarsind College of Pit Fighting with Stonesworn Crix and see Anvil's fighting pit. The Kindling Cadre, last seen fighting alongside the former slaves during the Orc Rebellion, return to court the Sun Chamber.
n.Jotun: Janon's herald refuses to discuss the boons the eternal grants the Jotun, calling them gifts for its friends in the west that would be cheapened if handed out to all.
